items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Each house, another house I’d hear Max Roach.

ctx.x: So in other words, three years before that my aunt gave me, my aunt who was a sister to this brother, gave me a “Charlie Parker with Strings” 78 for my birthday. And all of my mother’s sisters were married to amateur musicians. One was a drummer, one was a piano player. So each time when I’d go to everybody’s house, and I was an only child, music was my babysitter. So at one place I’d hear Erroll Garner, you know. At another place I’d hear Sarah Vaughan. Each house, another house I’d hear Max Roach. So I was…
